title: Which record controls a tokenized claim
shared: These studies follow the legal claim, ownership or position record, custody and correction rules behind a token. They share questions about which record controls and who is accountable when records disagree.
keep_distinct: Keep issuer ownership, Cede registration, DTC participant entitlements, downstream customer rights, wallet access and chain transfers separate. Rule approval does not establish an operating launch.
